title: Horizontal chain step: Γ|_{(ker Γ)^⊥} = L|_{(ker L)^⊥} ∘ (p_W ∘ B|_{(ker Γ)^⊥})
statement: Let V, X and Y be finite-dimensional real inner product spaces, B : V → X a bijective linear map, and L : X → Y and Γ : V → Y linear maps with Γv = L(Bv) for every v ∈ V. Let K ⊆ V and W ⊆ X be subspaces with K = ker Γ and W = (ker L)^⊥. Let p_W : X → W be the orthogonal projection (Submodule.orthogonalProjectionOnto, as a linear map), and let ι_{K^⊥} : K^⊥ → V and ι_W : W → X be the inclusions. Then normDet(Γ ∘ ι_{K^⊥}) = normDet(L ∘ ι_W) · normDet(p_W ∘ B ∘ ι_{K^⊥}).
lean_statement: ∀ {V X Y : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup X] [InnerProductSpace ℝ X] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Y] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Y] (B : V →ₗ[ℝ] X) (L : X →ₗ[ℝ] Y) (Γ : V →ₗ[ℝ] Y) (K : Submodule ℝ V) (W : Submodule ℝ X), Function.Bijective B → (∀ v, Γ v = L (B v)) → K = LinearMap.ker Γ → W = (LinearMap.ker L)ᗮ → (Γ ∘ₗ Kᗮ.subtype).normDet = (L ∘ₗ W.subtype).normDet * ((W.orthogonalProjectionOnto : X →ₗ[ℝ] W) ∘ₗ B ∘ₗ Kᗮ.subtype).normDet
